item.title: Bulletin updated at 16:30 HKT 19/Aug/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A trough of low pressure will bring heavy showers and thunderstorms to the coast of southern China and the northern part of the South China Sea tomorrow. With the trough of low pressure moving away, showers will lessen slightly over the coast of southern China early next week. A broad trough of low pressure is expected to bring unsettled weather to the central and northern parts of the South China Sea in the middle and latter parts of next week.

Date/Month: 20/08 (Sunday)
Wind: South force 2 to 3.
Weather: Mainly cloudy with occasional showers and squally thunderstorms. Showers will be heavy at times.
Temp range: 27 - 31 C
R.H. range: 75 - 95 per Cent
